Exploratory (X1; plan registered on OSF, osf.io/5c627); no verdict. X1 refits the LEACE eraser on the 158-case analysis region (training folds) and evaluates on held-out folds of the same population; step-5 values are the protocol LEACE fitted on the 278-case set. The linear E3-site value of X1 is a check of the procedure and does not gate X1. E3-site boundary 0.35 (one-sided upper bound); E2 criterion ΔAUC ≥ 0.05 and CI excluding 0. Intervals: case-level (cluster) bootstrap stratified by site (2,000 resamples).
